Sazmining Launches the Wild Sats Club, a Loyalty Program That Discounts Mining Management Fees as Customer Hashrate Grows

Sazmining, a Bitcoin Mining as a Service company founded in 2020 and led by CEO and Co-Founder Kent Halliburton, today launched the Wild Sats Club, a loyalty program with four tiers that lowers the management fee customers pay as their petahash under management grows. The program is open to existing and new customers starting today.
